positive.prompt: Audit toàn bộ codebase và tự động sửa lỗi
Scan code for bugs và apply fixes

evals.prompt: Audit codebase với 5 files, phát hiện bugs, code smells, và auto-fix
evals.expected_output: Audit report với findings list + auto-fixed code + verification results
expectations: Findings categorized by severity (Critical, High, Medium, Low)
Findings categorized by type (Bug, Code Smell, Performance, Security)
Manual fix recommendations for complex issues
Tests run after auto-fix to verify no regression
Confidence level based on fix success rate

evals.prompt: Audit với focus trên security issues (SQL injection, XSS, hardcoded secrets)
evals.expected_output: Security audit report với vulnerabilities + fixes applied
expectations: Fixes applied with security best practices
Security test cases added to verify fixes
